inputs.original_text: The IOC has finally put fairness and safety ahead of ideological pressure: transgender women and DSD athletes will be excluded from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games. Women’s sport exists to protect a fair category for female competitors, not to erase the distinction for political fashion. Kirsty Coventry put it plainly: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.” This is a necessary defense of women’s opportunity and the integrity of competition.
inputs.modified_text: The IOC is right to put fairness and safety ahead of ideological pressure. The female category exists to protect women’s opportunity to compete on fair terms, not to erase biological distinctions for political fashion. Kirsty Coventry put it plainly: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.” Excluding transgender women and DSD athletes from that category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games is a necessary defense of women’s sport and the integrity of competition.
